description.value:
You infuse a blaster weapon you're wielding with tech energy. For up to 1 hour, as long as you maintain concentration, the next twelve times the weapon strikes a target it deals an additional 1d6 fire damage, after which the power ends.

Overcharge Tech. Using a slot of 4th level or higher grants two additional shots for each slot level beyond 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
